3.name: aSi
3.desc: Table I encodes phiM as <=1.7e-5. Ref. [30] measured phiM=(1.7+/-0.1)e-5 at room temperature and k=(1.22+/-0.21)e-5 at 1550 nm after 400 C heat treatment.

4.name: SiO2:HfO2
4.desc: Silica-doped hafnia. T_annealed=400C, n=1.91 @1064nm. Thermo-optic properties (alpha, beta, kappa, C) taken from Jessica Steinlechner's MATLAB multimaterial code used for the ET-LF coating thermal noise paper (Kirans 2019). These values are not well-characterised at cryogenic temperatures but do not affect Brownian noise. phiM=3.7e-4 from MATLAB (paper quotes ~3.8e-4 at 10K). Poisson ratio 0.23 from MATLAB/paper.
